say:1:1630718001:1.text: Of course! What kind of magic school doesn't have a few ghosts floating around?

say:2:1630718002:1.text: I was just peeking at what he was writing. Next thing I know, he's howling and sprinting like I cast a banshee curse on him.
say:2:1630718002:1.source_cn: 这个学生，嘁，胆子小得很。我昨天不过是好奇他到底在写什...

say:3:1630718003:1.text: Honestly, what's there to be scared of? Give it a hundred years, we'll all be ghosts. Might as well get used to each other now.
say:3:1630718003:1.source_cn: 有什么好怕的嘛。过上几十年一百年，谁还不是个幽灵了。
say:3:1630718003:1.male: Honestly, what's there to be scared of? Give it a hundred years, we'll all be ghosts. Might as well get used to each other now.
say:3:1630718003:1.female: Honestly, what's there to be scared of? Give it a hundred years, we'll all be ghosts. Might as well get used to each other now.
